K = capital to build it: $17.32B ÷ sales-to-capital 4.34 = $3.99B
σ = 36% (its stock, a year of daily closes), T = 5 years, r = 4.91% → C = $1.63B
assets in place = NOPAT $431.5M ÷ WACC = $4.69B; value = ($4.69B + $1.63B − net debt $1.46B) ÷ 220,226,000 = $22.08

methods.fit: It is loss-making or growing fast: much of its value is the chance to become a larger, profitable business, which behaves like an option — worth more the more uncertain it is.
